subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff: privacy checklist + PO process (TidalHealth)
messages:
From: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra@tidalhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Moran <elise.moran@tidalhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: vendor setup + privacy checklist for TidalHealth

Hi Diego,

Thanks for agreeing to run a quick procurement kickoff with us. We're preparing to add Redwood as a vendor for our pilot (TL-2043) and need to confirm a few items up front so our procurement and security teams can proceed: 

- DPA: Do you require a signed DPA? If so, can you share your standard DPA and expected turn-around (we often push these to legal via DocuSign).
- Subprocessors: Please provide a current list of subprocessors (names, regions, purpose) or point us to a location where it's maintained.
- Data retention: What are your default data retention windows for logs, prompts, and embeddings? Any configurable retention options?
- Vendor setup / PO: We'll need the vendor onboarding form completed (attached), plus any instructions for PO numbers and invoicing. Who is your AP contact?

I've attached our procurement intake spreadsheet to speed things up: TidalHealth_procurement_form.xlsx (XLSX).

Can you confirm the above and share Redwood's onboarding packet so we can circulate internally? We're aiming to have vendor created and PO issued by end of next week.

Thanks,
Alejandra Ruiz
Procurement Manager | TidalHealth Inc.
alejandra@tidalhealth.com

Attachment: TidalHealth_procurement_form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra@tidalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup + privacy checklist for TidalHealth

Hi Alejandra — thanks for the clear list. We're excited to get you onboarded. Quick responses below and I've attached a starter packet to help your teams: Redwood_vendor_packet.pdf.

- DPA: Yes — we require a DPA for any customer handling production data. Our standard DPA is published (link below) and we can initiate a DocuSign when you confirm signatories.
- Subprocessors: I'll pull the canonical list and send it in a follow-up (we maintain a CSV that we refresh monthly).
- Data retention: Defaults are: logs (30 days), prompt traces (90 days), embeddings (90 days). We offer configurable retention for logs and prompt traces on dedicated/private plans; please tell me which data classes you're most concerned about and I can escalate.
- PO / vendor setup: Please complete the intake form and send back. For Po numbers, we accept PO on invoice; our AP contact is ap@redwood.com. If you prefer a W9 or vendor docs, let us know.

I'll coordinate with Laura (Contracts) and Monica (Finance ops) to get the subprocessors list and formal DPA executed.

Next steps:
1) We (Redwood) will attach: 1) standard DPA link, 2) current subprocessors CSV, 3) PO instructions PDF.
2) You send back the completed procurement form + nominal PO details.

Thanks — I'll follow up this afternoon with the subprocessors export.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Sales, East
Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (application/pdf)

Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup + privacy checklist for TidalHealth

Hi Alejandra / Diego — looping in our contracts and finance ops. Quick answers and attachments (see below):

1) DPA: Yes, Redwood requires a signed DPA for production usage. Our current standard DPA is here: https://drive.redwood.com/standards/DPA-Redwood-v2026.pdf. We normally execute via DocuSign; if you want internal legal review first, let us know signatory names and we'll route accordingly.

2) Subprocessors: Attached is the most recent export: subprocessors_list_2026.csv (name, vendor, purpose, region). We run a quarterly review and notify customers of material changes.

3) Data retention: As Diego noted — logs 30d, prompt traces 90d, embeddings 90d. For pilot customers we can enable a 30d prompt retention option; please indicate if you need that.

4) PO & vendor setup: Attached PO_instructions.pdf with AP routing and invoice requirements. We use the vendor portal for automatic vendor creation: https://vendor.redwood.com/setup-form?ref=TL-2043. Please have your AP include the PO number on the invoice; ap@redwood.com will confirm receipt.

Attachments included: subprocessors_list_2026.csv; PO_instructions.pdf

If your legal team needs redlines to the DPA, please send them to me and I'll coordinate with our legal counsel.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
